title: S100 4track-corner-pocket
description:
The Palisades S100 is CRL's thermally broken, high-performance sliding door system. It is Florida product approved and rated CW40, but it topped out at three tracks. Our architectural sales team was losing projects that needed more panels, a corner with no post, or panels that disappear into a wall, and many customers didn't know the system could be configured that way.

The program adds a 4-track configuration, a pocket option that stacks panels into a built-in wall, and a 90° corner with no fixed post, all within the S100's performance rating. The first application was a luxury showroom in Manhattan that needed all three at once.

metrics.label: Max panel size, up to 700 lb

brief.label: Problem
brief.text: Without 4-track, pocket and corner capability we lost projects, and neither customers nor our own sales team knew those configurations were possible.

brief.label: Solution
brief.text: New 4-track, pocket and 90° corner members for the S100, keeping its CW40 rating and thermally broken frame.

brief.label: Customers
brief.text: Architects and Division 8 contractors; hotels, government buildings, retail and hospitality.

brief.label: Value
brief.text: More configurations for architects on a high-performing, Florida-approved system.

brief.label: Risk
brief.text: Track can't be crimped on site, which makes long assemblies unwieldy to build and transport.

brief.label: Competition
brief.text: Western Window Systems 7600, Andersen MultiGlide, Mi Windows V2000, PRL Max.
